title: Glyph Morph
description: One Beatles word set huge in Geist on warm white. Click or press space and it becomes the next one, letter by letter: Help becomes Hello becomes Yellow becomes Yes, Blackbird sheds its Black and is Bird. Every glyph the two words share slides on a spring to its new place in the new word, keeping the font's kerning and the house tracking. Letters never cut each other: one that leaves keeps full ink where it stands and is wiped out of its own box just before the closing word reaches it, and a new one waits for its gap to open beside its kept neighbour, then wipes in inside it. Advance again mid-morph and it turns from wherever it is.
intent: From the Family wallet's Continue-to-Confirm label (https://benji.org/family-values): keep the shared letters and animate only what changes, so a state change reads without the noise of a crossfade. Here the label is the whole page.
